reason: The existing mapping to DORA Article 6(5) provides a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis. The provision explicitly requires the ICT risk management framework to be reviewed at least once a year, upon the occurrence of major ICT-related incidents, and following supervisory instructions, which directly corresponds to the control statement.
applicability_note: This control is directly applicable to all financial entities under the scope of DORA, as Article 6(5) is a core requirement for the ICT risk management framework.
challenge_comment: The control statement also mentions reviewing 'following a finding from testing'. While Article 6(5) covers 'conclusions derived from relevant digital operational resilience testing', the mapping remains adequate as the provision clearly supports this aspect of the control.
